name: Chakka Kuru Manga Curry

ingredients.name: raw green mango, peeled and chopped

steps: Peel the papery outer skin from the jackfruit seeds and remove any hard brown coating. Halve large seeds, cover with 450 ml water and simmer for 15 minutes until nearly tender.
Add raw mango, turmeric and salt to the jackfruit seeds. Simmer for 7 minutes more, until the mango softens but keeps some shape.
Grind grated coconut, cumin and green chilies with 150 ml water to a smooth paste. Stir the paste into the pot and simmer gently for 4 minutes; do not boil hard after adding coconut.
Heat coconut oil in a small pan. Let mustard seeds crackle, then add dried red chilies and curry leaves for 30 seconds. Pour this tempering over the curry.
Cover and rest for 5 minutes so the coconut and tempering mingle. Serve warm with steamed rice; taste first and add a little more salt only if the mango needs it.
tips: Jackfruit seeds must be fully cooked before eating. The tartness of raw mango varies; start with the stated amount and adjust at the end.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
